Package io.github.wankdanker.clyops

Interface Completer

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Completer
Lists the values of an option or argument (spec section 9.2). It gets a CompleteRequest and returns the values; throwing (or returning null) keeps the completion of the option's rule and makes --complete-values fail. It runs only for --bash-completion and --complete-values, so it should be quick and must not write to standard output.
